# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 20 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 20
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So then — it is a good thing to learn the Lord's righteous commandments, as many as are written, and to live by them. Whoever does this will be honored in God's kingdom. Whoever chooses the other path will go under along with everything they did.
2. That is why there is a resurrection. That is why there is a day of reckoning.
3. I ask those of you who hold positions of leadership: if you have received any good counsel at all, make it your goal to never push anyone away from among you. Love them all the more and work even harder for their salvation.
